designationHistory.name: Ruby Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Ruby Lake Migratory Waterfowl Refuge by Executive Order 7923 on July 2, 1938, and it was renamed Ruby Lake National Wildlife Refuge in 1940.
designationHistory.note: Pass A (FWS Realty establishment record) and Pass B (order text on the American Presidency Project; National Archives table) agree. Renamed Ruby Lake National Wildlife Refuge by Proclamation 2416, July 25, 1940.

sources.name: National Archives, Executive Orders Disposition Tables, 1938 (3 FR 1639)
